payout_quote: Trade in Today and Get Up to $15.00. *Trade-in price shown on this page is the real-time price based on quantity available and condition.
steps: Find your game or console on estarland.com and view the real-time trade-in price.
Add the items you own to a trade-in order and check out.
Ship your games or consoles to eStarland in excellent working order and good cosmetic condition.
Receive payment once your trade-in is received and accepted.
catches: Payout depends on the exact game or console, its condition and current demand - you must own the items you trade in; prices are real-time and can change.
Items must meet eStarland's quality standards (working order, good cosmetic condition); substandard items may have their value adjusted or be rejected and discarded.
Rejected items are discarded unless you arrange return shipping at your expense at the time of order placement.
biggest_catch: Payout depends entirely on which games or consoles you have, their condition and current demand - you must own them; the $15 figure is the real-time 'up to' price for one SNES game, not what every game earns.
eligibility: US; you must own the games or consoles you trade in; items must be in excellent working order and good cosmetic condition.
timing: Payment after receipt and acceptance; ~15-30 min active time to build the order and ship.
